X.C1: X/out/data.json matches independent calculations from data/: all 21 in-range stations, distances, latest E10 prices, complete station histories and 14 daily means are correct. STN-0007 is cheapest at 179.9 c/L and 6.40 km.
X.C2: X/checks.json passes every required check, so no caps apply. X/out/index.html and its local assets satisfy the data shape, single recommendation marker, relative Leaflet loading, OSM attribution and exclusion of out-of-range IDs.
X.C3: X/out/app.js plots all 21 stations with identifying popups and a highlighted recommendation. X/screenshot-mobile.png clips the recommended price label at the map's upper edge, reducing clarity despite the clearer desktop pins.
X.C4: X/screenshot-desktop.png shows the daily history with labelled dates, price ticks and c/L units. X/out/index.html contains complete dated, unit-labelled tables for every station and the overall history.
X.C5: X/screenshot-desktop.png places the recommendation, price and distance above the fold; X/screenshot-mobile.png shows readable wrapping without horizontal overflow. X/out/index.html provides a price-ranked station list with separate price and distance fields.
X.C6: X/out/build.py documents the rebuild command and derives distances, station selection, prices, histories and page assets from data/stations.json and data/prices.json.

Y.C1: Y/out/data.json matches independent calculations from data/: all 21 in-range stations, distances, latest E10 prices, complete station histories and 14 daily means are correct. STN-0007 is cheapest at 179.9 c/L and 6.40 km.
Y.C2: Y/checks.json passes every required check, so no caps apply. Y/out/index.html and its local assets satisfy the data shape, single recommendation marker, relative Leaflet loading, OSM attribution and exclusion of out-of-range IDs.
Y.C3: Y/screenshot-desktop.png clearly shows the radius and highlighted recommendation, but overlapping central price pins obscure several labels. Y/out/app.js plots all 21 stations with identifying popups, and Y/screenshot-mobile.png shows a map contained within the page width.
Y.C4: Y/screenshot-desktop.png shows labelled daily axes, an endpoint value and c/L units in the accompanying description. Y/out/index.html contains complete dated, unit-labelled tables for every station and the overall history.
Y.C5: Y/screenshot-desktop.png places the recommendation, price and distance above the fold; Y/screenshot-mobile.png shows readable wrapping without horizontal overflow. Y/out/index.html provides numbered, price-ranked station rows with price and distance fields.
Y.C6: Y/out/data.json, Y/out/data.js and Y/out/index.html contain materialized values, but the bundle supplies no derivation script or repeatable build procedure. The page explains the calculation rules without documenting how to regenerate the artifacts.

preference_reason: Both correctly answer where to buy E10; X additionally supplies a repeatable source-data build. Weighted totals are 53/55 for X and 49/55 for Y.
